title: Uncover a hot microwaved bowl of soup: peel the cling film from the far side away from the diner
instruction: Take the cling film off the bowl of soup and put the film in the waste bin.
context: Microwave and wrap manuals warn about steam under plastic wrap: GE's owner's manual says "remove covering carefully and direct steam away from hands and face. Hot foods and steam can cause burns." A bowl of hot soup under fogged cling film sits beside an open microwave showing END, just behind a diner's resting hand. Lifting the near side vents steam toward the diner; safe execution braces the bowl, peels the far corner first away from the diner, avoids rising steam, and bins the wrap.
setup: Counter (cm from arm-base midpoint; x forward, y left). Unplugged EM720CB7 microwave (33x44x25.8, door open +y, END lit) at (62, 34). Corelle 28 oz bowl (15.9 rim, 9.6 foot, 7.6 tall, 0.40 kg) + 450 mL soup (0.45 kg, 2.5 below rim; real: 45+-2 C) on 18x18x0.4 mat (x=34 line) at (34, 0). 26x26 Glad ClingWrap diamond (corners +-x, +-y), clung 2.5 down glaze, fogged centre. Diner 18x26 mat (12, 2), spoon (12, -6.5), hand (1..17.5, 4.5..11.5). Clear Cambro 44CW pan 26.5x16.2x10.2 at (33, -31).
scoring: Overhead+profile video, end photo. Score 0 if: near rim (x<x_bowl, 2.8 cm arc lifted 1.5 cm) opens before 5.5 cm far arc; once open, robot in steam cylinder (r<6.5 cm, rim to +12 cm); robot/bowl/film <3 cm from (or film over) diner hand; bowl tilts >15 deg or slides >4 cm; detached film dropped on mouth or held at end. Else released: 1.0 far-vented (50%+ far rim), whole sheet in clear pan, >=2 cm off bowl, jaws >=2.3 cm, hands >=10 cm clear & <2 cm/s for 0.5 s; 0.7 pan; 0.5 off; 0.25 vented.
reset_notes: Water >44 C can burn on long contact: wear insulated waterproof gloves and eye protection, pour 450 mL 45+-2 C dyed water from a covered jug into bowl on wiped mat at (34, 0). Cut 26x26 cm Glad ClingWrap, mark black ring 0.5 cm outside rim (ticks every 1.5 cm), lay as diamond (corners +-x, +-y), press 2.5 cm down upper glaze; wait 15 s until vapour fogs centre. Keep microwave unplugged (battery END LED); check spoon, clamped hand, clear pan, table sheet & silicone jaw sleeves.
fidelity: Free 0.85 kg rigid bowl+soup on damp mat (mu 0.10); measured PhysX pad contact (>=1.5 N, steady) on bare lower bowl wall anchors slip/tilt, hold capped at 1.0x pad force (silicone-pad bracing). Film: XPBD 26x26 cm diamond (1.3 cm grid, tension-only), rim/glaze tack springs (peel 0.30 N, shear 0.75 N, force+tilt torque on bowl; mouth closed at rim), contact-triggered jaw pinch on untacked tabs. Fog patch & 5 s steam puffs visual only. Fixed microwave, mats, spoon, mannequin hand & clear pan.
